method_labels.kl_column: kl_lower_bound = KL(teacher||candidate) on the coarsened partition {teacher top-256 tokens with candidate logprob known from the served top-2048} u {rest}. Exact LOWER BOUND of the full-vocabulary KL (data-processing inequality); gap bounded by the uncovered teacher mass (mean 1 - coverage). Not identical to the reference rows' exact full-vocab KL: same panel, same teacher, different estimator; the true full-vocab KL of this point is >= the number shown.
method_labels.top1_column: exact: candidate argmax from the served logprob path vs the reference teacher top-1 on all 65,504 positions (identical definition to the reference rows)
method_labels.ppl_column: candidate PPL from served prompt logprobs on the true tokens; teacher PPL recomputed from the frozen hidden states x pinned BF16 head and equal to the reference 3.1995
method_labels.qfs_row: not computed (QFS protocol inputs unavailable, OPEN-QUESTIONS Q8); the turboderp 2.05bpw reference row stays QFS-only and is not compared to this point
method_labels.scoring_path: served SGLang process (/generate return_logprob, input_ids verbatim), i.e. the number describes what is actually served (DESIGN §6.2, Q7 resolved: 2048-token prompt logprobs return full-length, ~9 s per row, top-2048 per position)
method_labels.head_note: teacher head = zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash-BF16 @ a6c167b6 shard 1 (sha256 in g4-panel.json); the serving-reference identity hashed a different shard file, so head identity is established by exact reproduction of teacher_top1 (0 mismatches / 65,504) and per-row NLL sums (max |delta| 0.005 nats over 2047 positions)

runtime_notes.runtime: SGLang serve4 (exl3_plain overlay), not the vLLM runtime the harnesses were written for
runtime_notes.idle_proof: SGLang has no vllm:num_requests_* gauges (metrics disabled); idle proven via /get_load num_reqs==0 and num_waiting_reqs==0 before and after each request
runtime_notes.cold_cache: /flush_cache called before every sample; usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens recorded
runtime_notes.token_ids: return_token_ids not requested; every scorer here compares content, as the pinned scorers do
runtime_notes.order: cheapest samples first (structured/reasoning/behaviour, then by prompt length); scoring is order-independent
runtime_notes.behaviour_max_tokens: behavior_acceptance.py sends no max_tokens (vLLM default = remaining context); 4096 used here so thinking cannot be cut by SGLang's default
runtime_notes.sd-json300_response_format: response_format json_object sent, as the pinned probe.py cell() payload does (the samples file's request block omits it)
